failure_modes: Full-frame fallback: document not dominant in frame -> quad = whole frame or arbitrary band (32, 40, 41, 42, 57, 58, 63). Dominant mode.
Salient sub-object lock-in: logo (38), wax seal (46), infobox (51), inner text block (47).
All id_card/driver_license/passport files have pdf_doc=false: PDFs were exported only for Wikimedia docs; MIDV outputs are crops only.
recommendations: Exclude or separately report the 6 non-document inputs (33,34,35,52,54,55) — full-frame 'detections' on them inflate the 87/95 detection rate.
Tighten min-quad-area / max-quad-area vs frame and reject near-frame quads unless the document truly fills the frame.
Sanity-check quad against the largest bright/rectangular region; reject quads whose area is a tiny fraction (38, 46) or a thin band (39, 42).
